parameters.apprise_url_plus: sfr://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.password_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.space_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own SFR destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-sfr_sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `sfr://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`user_secret`, `password_secret`, `space_id_secret`, `targets_secret`).

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SFR password

space_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SFR space id

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SFR targets

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SFR user
